claim: Pinned shipped source laws for Split Shot construction and Artemis target membership, plus explicitly synthetic Rust counterexamples and regression scope. No original selected execution, immediate original outcome, or complete game loop is admitted.

build.overlay_scope: Owner local modified inventory context. Overlay identity comes from the existing Centipede evidence receipt; it does not attest a new Split Shot or Artemis callback or game execution.

source_membership: Installed raw script hashes and sizes were compared with the named inventory members. Artemis, Brute, base, global and pawn identities also match the retained baseline source-pin review. These are source identity joins, not original execution attestations.

splitshot.endpoint: Compute GetProjectileEnd with PATH_PROJECTILE once during construction; retain its position before damage or push. First blocked tile is the endpoint; an unblocked ray ending outside the board backs up to the last valid tile.
splitshot.inheritance: All upgrades inherit the same effect body. A changes uses, B changes damage, AB changes both. TankDefault supplies projectile targeting and art; this body always supplies explicit main and side push directions.
splitshot.direction_order: Split Shot constructs Lua dir-1 before dir+1, opposite Centipede's dir+1 before dir-1. Lua and Rust direction-index tables differ; the vector offsets above are authoritative for translation.
splitshot.reachability: Ordinary weapon drop membership and Brute class establish a playable weapon configuration; no retained original equipped input is claimed.

artemis.target_membership: Inherited LineArtillery getter admits in-bounds cardinal target tiles at distances 2 through 8. OnlyEmpty is false, so buildings are admitted as centers. Base and A share this getter.
artemis.building_immunity: A suppresses direct center building damage while retaining cardinal outward pushes. Physical bump damage into buildings remains governed by existing model mechanics; source immunity does not remove the target from the getter.
artemis.excluded_variant_boundary: B and AB inherit the same shipped target getter, with center damage3. They have no current Rust WIds/mappings in this tranche and remain excluded from supported configuration comparisons; no substitution with base or A is allowed.

source_spans.role: A direct building immunity and building-centered illustration
ArtilleryDefault inheritance and center plus cardinal construction

splitshot_old_red.observation: The pre-fix Rust test failed on the absent primary forward push. Source inspection independently found that the projectile handler also omitted both side primitives. This is a model counterexample, not an original callback or endpoint.

artemis_old_illegal_target.observation: Synthetic building-center sacrifice witness was rejected by the old model despite the pinned Lua getter admitting the center. No original game outcome is attached.

remaining_gaps: Original selected Split Shot or Artemis execution association and immediate after-board are missing; shipped construction alone does not close native execution order or full action outcomes.
Heavy Rocket shares AOE_PERP but constructs three zero-damage outward neighbour pushes and no main push. Its missing footprint is a separate gap and is excluded from the Split Shot change.
CentipedeBoss trail ACID placement remains a separate source-order diagnostic, including possible terrain mutation from side explosions; no original consequential endpoint is admitted here.

TankDefault delegates target membership to native Board:GetSimpleReachable. Exact native target membership and equivalence of all target coordinates to four model directions remain open for Tank/Split Shot domains; explicit configured source-law fixtures do not promote the full legal-action gate.
Full compound damage, push, corpse, explosion and native scheduler interleaving is not proved by these source constructions or synthetic Rust replays.
Artemis B/AB model representation remains excluded until explicit Rust coverage and effective-loadout wiring are established.
publication_boundary: Only game-relative source identities, line spans and semantic facts are published. Proprietary source bodies and identifying local paths are omitted. Source-derived configuration checks and synthetic regressions remain separate from original archive admissions, held-out cases and solver-first gates.
